title: AGRICULTURAL AND FOOD FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
description: Explores fundamental financial concepts in the context of agriculture and food businesses, including analysis of financial ratios, the use of leverage, compounding and discounting, capital budgeting, and risk management. Emphasizes the application of these concepts and tools to management decisions.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: AEC 211 and (BA 211, 211H, 211Z, 211HZ or 315).
A minimum grade of D- is required in AEC 211, BA 211, BA 211H, BA 211Z, BA 211HZ and BA 315.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 10am-11:20am in LINC 268 - Learning Innovation Center 268 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
